question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **"more"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given options, **"more"** is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
 
• **"More"** is a phrasal verb that denotes a larger quantity than previously, typically, or compared to another thing.
 
• The comparative form of much and many is frequently thought of as being "**more**". 
 
 
• **Example:** She is **more** careful while crossing the road than any other things.
 
 
 
• Thus,*** option 4)*** is the correct alternative.
